The comb answers: what an event does to a cell

Ten kinds of event reach the game. Pick one and the moment since: cell_effect colours the cell gold, amber, red, grey or white, flash_alpha fades it, and cells_due batches new cells.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.
